data.body: **[P2] Avoid strongly rooting exporters in the ownership registry.** If a custom exporter references its plugin directly or through a callback, this global strong reference creates `registry → exporter → plugin → scheduler → lane`; the lane never dies, so its weakref callback cannot release the claim. The plugin and exporter then leak for the process lifetime, and the exporter cannot be reused. Store only weak lane references and compare each live lane's exporter identity (the lane already owns its exporter), and add a GC regression with an exporter back-reference.
